experiment: MNIST stage 6, frozen optical first layer; Iris retained

protocol.validation_selection: first 1000 per class after seeded permutation of official training set
protocol.preprocessing: pixels/255; training-only centered PCA16; no whitening or extra standardization
protocol.readout: fixed-reference real quadrature after digital scale recovery
protocol.limitations: Shared test set; pure quantization repeats are duplicates; empirical spreads are not confidence intervals

pass_meaning: numerical equivalence and passivity, no noisy accuracy threshold
